mapper.delete: /* EpnMapper.deleteEpn : EPN 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_ECM_EPN WHERE EPN_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
mapper.select: /* EpnMapper.selectEpnList : EPN 조회 */ SELECT epn.EPN_JOB_NO ,epn.HBL_NO ,epn.CLEARANCE_TYPE ,epn.LICENSE_NO ,epn.PIECES ,epn.UNIT_PIECES ,epn.GWT ,epn.SPLIT_YN ,epn.SPLIT_SEQ ,epn.PACKING_CODE ,epn.PACKING_PIECES ,epn.SHIPPER_NAME ,epn.CARRYIN_DATE ,epn.SEND_DATE_TIME ,epn.SHIPPER_BUSINESS_ID ,epn.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,epn.MAKER_NAME ,epn.DEST_COUNTRY ,epn.LICENSE_REMARK ,epn.EMERGENCY_YN ,epn.HS_CODE ,epn.ITEM_NAME ,epn.ECM_TYPE ,epn.ECM_ITEM_NAME ,epn.REMARKS ,epn.CHECK_REQUEST ,epn.CHECK_RESULT ,epn.INSPECTION_REQUEST ,epn.INSPECTION_RESULT ,epn.ITEM_AMOUNT_CUR ,epn.ITEM_AMOUNT_LOC ,epn.DECLARATION_AMOUNT_CUR ,epn.DECLARATION_AMOUNT_LOC ,epn.ITEM_DELIVERY_FEE ,epn.ITEM_INSURANCE ,epn.PAY_AMOUNT ,epn.CB_RECEIPT_DATE_TIME ,epn.CB_RECV_DATE_TIME ,epn.CB_TS_YN ,epn.MF_TS_YN ,epn.TS_REGISTER_INFO ,epn.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,epn.UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT USER_LOGIN_ID FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND USER_ID = epn.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_LOGIN_ID FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND USER_ID = epn.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME ,epn.OB_DATE FROM TB_ECM_EPN epn WHERE epn.EPN_JOB_NO = #{epnJobNo}
